question: resheph is recorded with more than one father: ephraim, rephah.

actions.why: The Hebrew coordinates Rephah and Resheph (וְרֶפַח בְּנוֹ וְרֶשֶׁף), without calling Resheph Rephah's son; the KJV likewise reads 'also Resheph.' The Rephah-to-Resheph fatherhood is an unsupported extraction.

note: Retain the sibling relationship and the existing Ephraim relationships. The following 'Telah his son' supports the Resheph–Telah relationship.
